_comment: Packages below the 80% coverage floor when the gate landed (sdk#356). Burndown: sdk#388. Each entry is held at its recorded level (no regression) and removed once it reaches 80%. Regenerate with `make coverage-baseline`. These numbers are toolchain-dependent: `go test -cover` counts statements, and the count changes between Go releases. Re-recorded under go1.27.2, the floor in go.mod. Moving the floor toolchain moves these numbers in both directions on an unchanged tree, so re-record this file in the same PR that moves the floor.
